title: Early Acceptance Multiplier on Small Business Electricity Supply Renewal Loyalty Credits
content:
A business that settles its renewal well before the new term begins earns a larger renewal loyalty credit.

**Timing multiplier.** On the renewal loyalty credit of a Small Business Electricity Supply agreement, the calendar days from the acceptance date to the start date of the renewed term are counted; 30 days or more multiply the loyalty subtotal by 1.25; 14 to 29 days multiply it by 1.10; fewer than 14 days leave it unchanged.

The acceptance date is the renewal election date on the agreement record, and the start date of the renewed term is the plan change date recorded for it. The count is the difference in calendar days between the two dates.

| Calendar days from acceptance to the renewed term's start | Effect on the loyalty subtotal |
|---|---|
| 30 or more | multiplied by 1.25 |
| 14 to 29 | multiplied by 1.10 |
| fewer than 14 | unchanged |

**Boundaries (hypothetical renewed term starting 1 January)**

| Acceptance date | Days | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| 2 December | 30 | multiplied by 1.25 |
| 3 December | 29 | multiplied by 1.10 |
| 18 December | 14 | multiplied by 1.10 |
| 19 December | 13 | unchanged |

**Hypothetical figure.** A loyalty subtotal of 140.00 USD multiplied by 1.25 is 175.00 USD.
